rites.name: Valaunum
rites.text: Valaunum is the concept of a resonant hum that runs through the stone of Jorernodath during the Singing, when the first roots of the world take hold. Holy orders of the flame age taught that it was the voice by which the land agreed to be solid. Temples were raised so that its pitch could be kept steady.

rites.name: Zephyushora
rites.text: Zephyushora is a concept of the Jorernodath Weave, imagined as a slow current of stilled wind that the makers carry through the Seeding to wake quiet powers. Its gentle pressure loosens dormant sparks in the ground and the air without ever breaking them free.

rites.name: Naurium
rites.text: Naurium is a concept in Jorernodath, a grounded realm, set during the Seeding when the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers lie dormant. It is a mineral that hums faintly when it is near its own kind, and it was once used to bind threads of the Weave together. Its power is small and steady rather than dramatic.

rites.name: Anatakaluta
rites.text: Anatakaluta is a binding concept of the Jorernodath Fall, the principle that a sworn oath can hold a fracturing world together after its bonds have broken. In the Age of Sundering, landfall pressed many communities toward the Pact, and the concept shaped how they kept their promises. It is remembered as a discipline of keeping faith under strain rather than as a force of destruction.

rites.name: Oreorus
rites.text: Oreorus is a concept in Jorernodath that names the bond of shared breath between the ferrymen of the Fall and the drowned shores they carried. It was first spoken during the Sundering, when landfall split old alliances and the Pact was sworn over the broken ground.

rites.name: Nintus
rites.text: Nintus is a concept in Jorernodath, a grounded idea of the Walled Age, when holding walls, orders and churches rose and the first sovereign ruled over growing kingdoms and groves. It is remembered as the notion that a wall is only as strong as the hands that keep it mended.

rites.name: Osumarkanum
rites.text: Osumarkanum is a concept in Jorernodath, a seed-pattern that the Library of the Three Futures files whenever a sovereign's grove begins to grow into a kingdom. It is less a thing than a habit of the land, the way a sprouting root finds the water under a field. Scholars of the Age of the first sovereign describe it as the quiet force that lets groves outlast their keepers.

rites.name: Kournoth
rites.text: Kournoth is a concept in Jorernodath, a thought-form the Library of the Three Futures files whenever an ending branches into several shelved outcomes. During the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it is invoked by scribes who weigh one possible future against another.

rites.name: Crerock
rites.text: Crerock is a concept in Jorernodath, a notion that the Library of the Three Futures shelves each branching ending during the Holy Age of flame and temple orders. It is most often invoked in the grounded powers of the age, where it marks the moment a chosen path is sealed in ink.
